vulnerability_mechanism.evidence: CVE.org currently records CVE-2025-25207 as PUBLISHED with CWE-770 and describes a developer-persona attacker adding many post-authorization HTTP callbacks to exhaust a single Authorino instance. The BIC exposes an unbounded spec.notify array, the controller translates every entry, and evaluateNotifyConfigs routes each priority group through evaluateAnyAuthConfig; evaluateAuthConfigs creates one goroutine per config.

atomic_bic.evidence: f8895e464ed34300b8aa0e43c410b765c73ff6b4 is the smallest public first-write of the complete vulnerable mechanism: it adds AuthConfigSpec.Notify without MaxItems, the HTTP notify evaluator and controller translation, and the phase-5 concurrent execution path. A path-limited -S history finds this commit as the original addition; 1f58b03783bc4d0d4115b62ae64678b17d018350 only renames notify to callbacks.

immediate_parent_absence.evidence: The BIC has exactly one parent, 5d1eeea6f0e4cfcfb94fff3cf1fb39b4e1a74565. Direct parent-tree inspection shows AuthConfigSpec ending after Response/DenyWith, no pkg/evaluators/notify.go, and no Spec.Notify, NotifyConfigs, evaluateNotifyConfigs, or json notify field.

squash_member_decomposition.evidence: PR #368 was not a squash: its base is 5d1eeea6f0e4cfcfb94fff3cf1fb39b4e1a74565, it contains feature commit f8895e464ed34300b8aa0e43c410b765c73ff6b4 followed by docs-only commit 03c7201bff8d59a2a8e9e492dc3bfdc4f6b92e4b, and merge fc315fa1976aa3c4767ae69ece7364eaf0a95c87 has both the base and PR head as parents. The feature commit, not the docs member or merge, is the atomic BIC.

affected_release_membership.evidence: merge-base checks show the BIC is not an ancestor of v0.11.0 but is an ancestor of v0.12.0, v0.20.0, and v0.27.0. v0.20.0 retains an unbounded Callbacks map and executeCallbacks fan-out, matching GHSA's affected range <= 0.20.0; v0.27.0 remains vulnerable in source as well.

fixed_release_membership.evidence: There is no fixed release to map: the current GHSA record has first_patched_version=null, the current CVE record lists affected products without a fixed version, and Bugzilla 2347421 remains NEW with empty resolution and Fixed In Version. The newest tag v0.27.0 still has the unbounded callback map and execution path.

direct_fix_or_unpatched_state.evidence: Verified unpatched. GitHub's current main SHA equals local HEAD 2649c9a10dbdff85dce6a7db6a1b534f54c38242; its API type has Callbacks map[string]CallbackSpec without a callback MaxProperties bound, its CRD callbacks object has additionalProperties without maxProperties, the controller ranges every callback, and executeCallbacks still fans the group through evaluateAnyAuthConfig. Commit 9eac615dbe695f7dadb3eeb7240f2ab4266649f7 limits HTTP response bytes only, is not on HEAD, and does not bound callback cardinality.

bic_only_ai_attribution.evidence: Attribution was checked only on BIC f8895e464ed34300b8aa0e43c410b765c73ff6b4. Its author and committer are Guilherme Cassolato <guicassolato@gmail.com>, its raw commit object contains a GPG signature and no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI marker, and PR #368 was opened and merged by guicassolato. The later AI-marked response-size commit 9eac615d is not used for BIC attribution.

findings: The primary mechanism, BIC, parent, release-boundary, unpatched-state, and BIC-only authorship claims independently reproduce from the designated clone and current advisory records.
The current CVE record remains PUBLISHED, GHSA-r8xr-pgv5-gxw3 remains unwithdrawn with no patched version, and upstream main remains unpatched for callback cardinality.
Primary verdict NOT_AI is sustained; no corrected field is required.
remaining_gap: Upstream remains unpatched: no commit or release caps AuthConfig callback cardinality or bounds callback fan-out; this is a remediation gap, not an attribution evidence gap.
